name: Traveler's Backpack Addons
description: Extra upgrades for Traveler's Backpack: Tool Swapper, Stack Upgrades (x2 / x4 / x8 stack size), Soulbound and Mob Ward (no hostile spawns around you), plus the worn backpack shown next to chests. With Tom's Simple Storage installed, its terminals also show and use the items in your backpacks.
